normalized.description: SMARTPLY Europe DAC is seeking expressions of interest from suitably qualified and experienced small to medium sized construction companies to undertake a number of minor construction work packages at its manufacturing facility in Belview, Slieveure, Waterford. The proposed works comprise a number of minor construction projects across the production facility, primarily addressing Health and Safety, Environmental and operational requirements. The works have been divided into four separate lots based on the nature and type of the projects. SMARTPLY Europe DAC has engaged Malone O Regan to assist with the preparation of the tender drawings and associated documentation to enable contractors to fully assess and price the required works. Full details of the scope of works are provided within the drawings and tender documentation issued as part of this package. The works are anticipated to commence in Q4 2026 and are expected to be completed over a period of approximately four months.

normalized.description:
Open Research Europe (ORE) is the open access peer-reviewed publishing platform offered by the Commission as an optional service to Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe beneficiaries at no cost to them. It was launched in March 2021 and currently has approximately 500 publications and 900 peer-reviews. ORE follows an innovative open access publishing model for articles, which is based on open peer-review after publication (post-publication peer-review). 
The Commission’s vision, in collaboration with a number of national funders, is that as of 2026 ORE will transition from a publishing platform for Horizon 2020 and Horizon Europe beneficiaries into a publishing platform for which responsibility could be shared with Member State funders and possibly also research performing organisations.
The Commission is herewith tendering the open source publishing platform that will underpin ORE as of 2026, which will be largely based on existing open source software for scientific publishing.
